story.fullStory:
Bread's "Guitar Man" — original release 1972. Guitar Man is the fifth album by Bread, released in 1972.

Bread was an American soft rock band from Los Angeles, California.

They had 13 songs chart on the Billboard Hot 100 between 1970 and 1977.

The band was fronted by David Gates (vocals, bass guitar, guitar, keyboards, violin, viola, percussion) with Jimmy Griffin (vocals, guitar, keyboards, percussion) and Robb Royer (bass guitar, guitar, flute, keyboards, percussion, recorder, backing vocals).
